profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ServiceNow
profile.summary: Well rounded and highly adaptable Software Engineer; excited to learn, build, and work with tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Core contributor on ServiceNow's Build Agent

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Code Assist: Improved the ServiceNow platform developer experience by integrating AI capabilities (code suggestions, code editing, and autocomplete) into ServiceNow's script editors (Now Assist).

Service Reliability Management: Developed ServiceNow's Service Reliability Management solution. Think configuration and management of SLIs, SLAs, and SLOs.

Lightstep Incident Response (Project AIR): Built incident response capabilities within ServiceNow. Think on-call management, alerts, and response workflows.

Service Portfolio Management: Contributed to ServiceNow's Service Portfolio Management solution. Think tracking, analysis, and optimization of IT services

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Walkup Experience: Built interfaces and back end logic for ServiceNow's IT help desk product.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to Allscripts' electronic health record and patient management platform.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Software Developer
positions.description: Co-founded a public transportation startup called "ChickenBus" which was focused on serving and aggregating transit data for developing countries.

positions.title: Radio Host
positions.description: For years, I worked at UNC-Chapel Hill's freeform radio station WXYC (89.3 FM), broadcasting and curating music programming. WXYC has a vast physical music library that deepened my appreciation for music discovery and no doubt influenced my personal and professional trajectory.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I started my software engineering career as an Intern at IBM, gaining hands-on experience in software development and contributing to real-world projects.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description: At UNC Chapel Hill, I provided on-site technical support as an IT Technician while I earned my Computer Science B.S. For anyone in the ServiceNow world that might be curious, we used Remedy for ITSM.
